subject: Live chat latency — interim configs, mitigation steps, and timeline
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tao <alex@chirplive.com>
Cc: ChirpLive Ops <ops@chirplive.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Live chat latency — we see elevated end-to-end times

Hi Alex,

We observed an increase in end-to-end latency for your live chat streaming endpoint starting ~09:00 UTC. Our telemetry shows higher token emission delays and increased queuing at a small subset of edge shards that route ChirpLive traffic.

What we have done so far:
- Isolated affected edge shard pool and routed new streams to healthy capacity.
- Applied an emergency KV-cache bypass for requests hitting the problematic path.
- Scoped mitigation to ChirpLive tenant to avoid broader impact.

Immediate customer-facing actions you can take (short-term):
1) Implement a conservative client-side backoff: exponential retries with initial delay 150ms for streaming chunk failures.
2) If you use streaming to update UI progressively, enable short polling fallback every 800ms for critical screens.
3) Temporarily reduce per-request max tokens from 1024 -> 512 for peak paths.

We attach a CSV snippet with the traces we pulled for your tenant (inc-20271211-telemetry.csv). Were continuing to investigate root cause and will follow up with a timeline for a full postmortem.

Can we schedule a 30-minute check-in at 11:00 UTC? If that doesnt work, tell me a time window and well adapt.

Thanks and apologies for the disruption — I know this impacts your real-time experience.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Laura/Marissa,

Short answers for customer (sendable before 10:30):
- Credits/SLA: recommend offering a 7-day service credit equivalent to 10% of the impacted window billable tokens as a good-faith interim. Keep the final number pending postmortem if we find larger impact. This is within standard CS playbook for asymmetric latency incidents.
- Risk to in-flight messages: low. The temp configs were proposing are conservative: reducing max tokens per request truncates long single requests but preserves chunking. The short-poll fallback is additive (clients will continue to receive chunks when available). Well enable guarded retries server-side to avoid duplicate deliveries. Recommend advising customer to enable idempotency keys for any transactional messages for the next 48 hours.

Immediate ops steps (we will do now):
1) Pin new routing for ChirpLive to healthy edge pool for next 6 hours.
2) Apply KV-cache bypass (already done).
3) Increase token emission worker concurrency on healthy shards by +20% to drain queues.
4) Enable guarded server-side retries (dedupe by idempotency key).

Proposed message for customer (short):
"Were sorry for the disruption. We have routed your traffic to healthy capacity and applied temporary settings that significantly reduce queuing. We recommend applying two client-side steps (reduce per-request tokens and short-poll fallback). We propose a 7-day, 10% interim service credit for the impacted window and will confirm final compensation after our postmortem. Our engineering team will share a root-cause timeline in 72 hours."

Im attaching a quick mitigation doc (mitigation_steps.md) with the exact commands and the temporary-config-snippets.txt you can push to your engineers.

Rishi
Sr. Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: mitigation_steps.md (Markdown, 8 KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tao <alex@chirplive.com>
Cc: ChirpLive Ops <ops@chirplive.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2027 10:42:05 -0000
Subject: Re: Live chat latency — interim configs, mitigation steps, and timeline

Alex — thank you for the quick reply and for joining the 11:00 UTC check. Per our internal recommendations, below are the concise steps were asking you to apply and what Redwood will do on our side.

Customer action (apply immediately):
- Reduce per-request max tokens: current 1024 -> 512.
- Enable short-poll fallback for critical UIs: poll at 800ms for the next 48h.
- Add idempotency keys for any send-message API calls for 48h to avoid duplicate processing if retries occur.

Redwood actions (already or in-flight):
- Routed traffic away from affected edge shards and increased emission worker concurrency.
- Applied KV-cache bypass for the affected path.
- Enabling guarded server-side retries with dedupe on idempotency keys.

Compensation and timeline:
- Interim compensation: 7-day service credit roughly equivalent to 10% of the estimated impacted billable tokens for the incident window. We will finalize after the postmortem if we identify a materially larger impact.
- Root-cause & postmortem ETA: preliminary timeline within 72 hours (well share a full postmortem PDF and remediation plan).

Next steps:
- ChirpLive to confirm if you accept the interim credit offer; well provision it immediately upon confirmation.
- Well send the postmortem link to the Drive doc (shared) and follow up with scheduled remediation items.

Thanks again for the patience. We know streaming quality is core to your product and were prioritizing finish-to-finish follow-through on this one.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
